page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one column, with marginal notes in the right margin. Heading lines and the QUÆST. II. heading (with brace) stand at full width. Page number at top right. Running head at top. Catchword and gathering signature at foot.

p.i: igitur vel olim Scholastici aliqui, vel circa initium hodierni Schismatis Scriptores aliqui Catholici de hac præparatione hominis ante Gratiam, & consequenter de viribus humanæ naturæ nondum sanatæ imprudenter scripserunt; non est illud hodie ab aliquo Authore Catholico defensum: sed juxta Concilii Tridentini definitionem, & plurimorum hodieTractatorum Catholicorum consentientes sententias, in confesso omnibus est, Vires naturæ sic per peccatum Originale fractas esse & debilitatas, ut sine habituali dono, per Christi gratiam infuso, neq; Deum diligere, vel ullum opus bonum, ut oportet, & ut Meritorium esse queat, præstare valeant: neq; sine speciali Dei auxilio per liberum arbitrium ad oblatum Gratia donum acceptandum cooperari. Hæc ille.
Nos igitur nè, veluti {*}ἀέρα δέρων[?], absq; Adversariis pugnare videamur, missum faciemus hoc Membrum speciei primæ de Merito ex Congruo.

main_text.head: QUÆST. II. De Dispositionibus, quibus Peccatores ad Gratiam ex Gratia excitantur.
SECT. II.
main_text.p: DE quibus sic statuit Bellarminus, {c}Hæ non excludunt Meritum, modo non tribuatur eis Meritum de Condigno. Rursus, Nos quidem intelligere non possumus, cur non sit hoc tempo-Bellar. lib. 1. de Justif. cap. 21.

page.notes: Greek after the asterisk is uncertain (probably ἀέρα δέρων, 1 Cor. 9:26); marked [?]. Running head taken as printed, including the section number 2. Text on the right side of the scan is show-through from the reverse page and is left out. The printed comma after "Bellarminus" is read as a comma; the mark c is placed in the text where it stands. Heading "SECT. II." given level 1 with caput 2 as a division.
